value.rationale: The cutoff counts macroscopic permutation blocks, a natural Poisson–Dirichlet observable, while total cycles measures fragmentation. Their dependence cannot be inferred from marginal limits; a unique crossover identifies where raising fragmentation concentration ceases to increase large-block counts. The theta small/large endpoint constants yield a natural two-regime scale law (1/2 versus 0.434818/theta), not a parameter rename or routine marginal expectation. The exact finite sign classification adds a model-wide statement beyond isolated calculations.
